opportunities.name: Inferno lifesteal armor shred
opportunities.objective: Test inferno lifesteal armor shred against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Inferno Trigger explicitly applies lifesteal at 100% effectiveness and its ten physical shots can crit; Bloodthirster plus Visage tests survival during the two-second channel. Cleaver supports physical damage, while Essence Reaver keeps one Spellblade available during style-building attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Build S with distinct attacks/abilities before entering R range.
opportunities.failure: CC interrupts R and missing damage prevents the E takedown reset.
opportunities.test: Measure R healing versus one and multiple champions at equal health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R lifesteal does not imply every shot applies all basic-attack on-hits.

opportunities.name: Style health-to-AD diver
opportunities.objective: Test style health-to-ad diver against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Melee Daredevil Impulse adds AD-scaled magic damage at low target health while Q/R remain largely physical; Bloodmail supplies health-linked AD and Shojin supports building style with distinct spells. Eclipse and Death's Dance help reach an actual first takedown for E reset.
opportunities.requiredState: Alternate distinct style inputs and fight inside melee bonus range.
opportunities.failure: No crit or lifesteal sharply weakens the standard R carry pattern.
opportunities.test: Compare time to S and survival through first R against a crit build.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rapid repeated Q alone does not grant six distinct style grades.

ruledOut.reason: R lifesteal does not imply every shot applies all basic-attack on-hits.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Inferno lifesteal armor shred
builds.summary: Test inferno lifesteal armor shred against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test inferno lifesteal armor shred against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Inferno Trigger explicitly applies lifesteal at 100% effectiveness and its ten physical shots can crit; Bloodthirster plus Visage tests survival during the two-second channel. Cleaver supports physical damage, while Essence Reaver keeps one Spellblade available during style-building attacks.
testPlan: Required state: Build S with distinct attacks/abilities before entering R range.
Measure R healing versus one and multiple champions at equal health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: CC interrupts R and missing damage prevents the E takedown reset.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R lifesteal does not imply every shot applies all basic-attack on-hits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Bloodthirster, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Infinity Edge, Essence Reaver, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing [50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage and gaining [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Speed for [5] seconds. 

If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.

Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating.

Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing [20 / 40 / 60 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage and applying Life Steal at [100]% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike.

Samira fires a shot, dealing [0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage to the first enemy hit.

If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing [0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

Samira builds a combo by dealing damage with Attacks or Abilities against enemy champions unique from the previous one. Each one increases her Style, from "E" to "S" grade (6 total). Samira gains @MSBonusNew@ Move Speed per grade.

Samira's Attacks and Abilities in melee range deal an additional [(0.1) × AD + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=1, changes=[])] magic damage, increased up to @EmpoweredMeleeDamageTooltip@ based on the target's missing Health.

Samira's Attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her Attack Range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up for at least 0.5 seconds.

Samira slashes around her for [0.75] seconds, damaging enemies twice for [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area.

Samira builds a combo by dealing damage with Attacks or Abilities against enemy champions unique from the previous one. Each one increases her Style, from "E" to "S" grade (6 total). Samira gains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.0275, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0024999999441206455, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0024999999441206455, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0024999999441206455, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Move Speed per grade.

Samira's Attacks and Abilities in melee range deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=1, changes=[]) + (characterLevelInterpolation(0.035 → 0.105; raw flags preserved)) × AD] magic damage, increased up to [(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=1, changes=[]) + (characterLevelInterpolation(0.035 → 0.105; raw flags preserved)) × AD) × (2)] based on the target's missing Health.

Samira's Attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her Attack Range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up for at least 0.5 seconds.
